blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In this work, we address real-time fine-grained human activity recognition (HAR) in industrial assembly and introduce PDNet, a new framework that jointly exploits structured pruning and knowledge distillation for 3D convolutional networks. We start by training a 3D-CNN backbone in a supervised manner. Then, PDNet applies channel-wise structured pruning to obtain a more compact network. In the third step, our method is optimized using knowledge distillation from the large unpruned teacher to recover accuracy lost due to pruning. On the challenging MECCANO dataset with an X3D-M backbone, the pruned model without distillation reaches a Top-1 accuracy of 25.54 %, while PDNet raises this to 39.46 %, with only 6.90 MB model size and 3.78 GFLOPs. These results show that distillation within PDNet is highly effective in restoring pruned model performance and highlight its high potential for resource-constrained HAR in industrial assembly.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们在工业组装中处理实时精细的人类活动识别(HAR),并引入了PDNet,这个新框架共同利用结构化的分泌和知识分馏为3D分化网络. 我们首先以监督的方式培训3D-CNN骨干。 然后,PDNet应用频道结构化的浏览来获得更紧凑的网络. 在第三步,我们的方法被优化了,利用了来自大而未被推倒的老师的知识分馏来恢复被推倒而失去的精度. 在具有X3D-M主干线的具有挑战性的MECCANO数据集上,未蒸馏的被碾磨过的模型达到Top-1精度25.54%,而PDNet则将其提升到39.46%,只有6.90 MB模型大小和3.78 GFLOP. 这些结果显示,PDNet内部的蒸馏在恢复被磨损的模型性能方面非常有效,并突出了其在工业组装方面对资源有限制的HAR的高度潜力.

blocks.en: 1 INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In the context of modern manufacturing, often framed under the paradigm of Industry 4.0, artificial intelligence and, in particular, deep learning have become a key enabler.
An important element of such systems is the real-time analysis of worker activities , which enables the quantification and evaluation of human performance during complex assembly operations Tao et al. ((2018)) ; Chen et al. ((2022)) .
By accurately recognizing and predicting worker actions, these intelligent systems can provide immediate assistance and guidance, thereby optimizing assembly processes and ensuring adherence to standard operating procedures.
This capability is also essential for fostering effective human-robot collaboration Al-Amin et al. ((2020)) and can significantly reduce operational errors, directly advancing the core objectives of smart manufacturing Chen et al. ((2020)) .
blocks.zh:
在现代制造业中,常常被置于"工业4.0"的范式下,人工智能,特别是深度学习已经成为一种关键的推动因素.
这种系统的一个重要内容是对工人活动进行实时分析,以便能够量化和评估 Tao等人((2018))复杂组装作业期间的人类表现; 陈等 ((2022).
通过准确识别和预测工人的行动,这些智能系统能够提供即时援助和指导,从而优化装配流程并确保遵守标准作业程序。
这种能力对于促进有效的人-机器人协作Al-Amin等人(2020年)也至关重要,并可大大减少操作错误,直接推进智能制造陈等人(2020年)的核心目标。

The X-axis shows CPU inference time per clip (ms) and the Y-axis Top-1 accuracy, the circle area encodes model size. Our pruned X3D with knowledge distillation (PDNet, red) recovers most of the accuracy lost by the pruned baseline (purple).

blocks.en:
Deep learning-based human activity recognition models, for example architectures based on 3D convolutional neural networks (3D CNNs) Ji et al. ((2013)) , play a key role in this context.
Such models can jointly capture spatial appearance and temporal dynamics from video streams, enabling accurate identification of complex actions Ji et al. ((2013)) .
Their ability to model complex motion patterns makes them especially suitable for industrial settings, where accurately recognizing subtle worker activities is critical Tran et al. ((2015)) .
blocks.zh:
基于深层学习的人类活动识别模型,例如基于3D进化神经网络的架构(3D CNN) Ji等人((2013年))在这方面发挥了关键作用。
此类模型可以共同从视频流中捕捉出空间外观和时间动态,从而能够准确识别出复杂的动作Ji等((2013).)。
它们模拟复杂运动模式的能力使它们特别适合工业环境,在工业环境中,准确识别微妙的工人活动是关键的Tran等人((2015年))。

blocks.en: However, by extending convolutions into the temporal dimension, 3D architectures typically require substantially more parameters and computations than their 2D counterparts, which complicates deployment under tight resource constraints. Standard architectures such as I3D-ResNet50 exceed 25 GFLOPs, which makes them unsuitable for real-time or edge applications Hedegaard & Iosifidis ((2022)) . Efficient architectural designs, such as lightweight 3D backbones, aim to balance computational cost and accuracy Feichtenhofer ((2020)) . Additional strategies, including model quantization and pruning, are often applied to reduce model size and inference latency, which supports deployment on resource-constrained embedded systems and FPGA accelerators Toupas et al. ((2023)) . Together, these techniques are crucial for achieving real-time operation in industrial environments Toupas et al. ((2023)) . In addition to architecture-level and compression strategies, input-level efficiency has also been explored. For example, Noor et al. Noor & Park ((2023)) propose a lightweight skeleton-based 3D-CNN that operates directly on sequences of human joint keypoints rather than RGB frames. By using pose sequences as input, the network drastically reduces input dimensionality and removes irrelevant background information, enabling a compact 3D-CNN to achieve real-time inference with low latency while maintaining strong accuracy for fall detection and general action recognition. At the same time, another compression technique, knowledge distillation, has gained traction across many domains and has been explored to improve accuracy of heavily compressed models for driver activity recognition Tanama et al. ((2023)) . Yet, there is little work that explores pruning and knowledge distillation for 3D CNNs in general activity recognition as well as in the industrial assembly domain: most existing efforts either target 2D architectures or apply compression techniques in isolation.
blocks.zh: 然而,三维架构通过扩展到时间维度,通常需要比其二维对应参数多得多的参数和计算,这使得在资源紧缺的情况下部署更加复杂. I3D-ResNet50等标准架构超过25个GFLOP,这使得它们不适合实时或边缘应用Hedegaard & Iosifidis ((2022)). 高效的建筑设计,如轻量级3D主干线,旨在平衡计算成本和精度Feichtenhofer((2020)). 其他一些战略,包括模型量化和推算,经常被应用来减少模型大小和推论延迟,支持在资源受限的嵌入式系统和FPGA加速器Toupas等人(((2023)))上部署. 这些技术对在工业环境中实现实时运行至关重要。 除了架构层面和压缩策略外,还探索了投入层面的效率. 例如,诺尔等. Noor & Park ((2023)) 提出以轻量级骨架为主的3D-CNN,直接运行在人类联合键点的序列上,而不是RGB帧上. 通过将姿势序列作为输入,网络会大幅降低输入维度并去除不相干的背景信息,使一个紧凑的3D-CNN能够以低延迟度实现实时推论,同时保持强烈的精确度来进行秋季探测和一般动作识别. 同时,另一种压缩技术,即知识蒸馏,在许多领域获得了牵引力并被探索,以提高对驱动器活动识别Tanama等人((2023))的重压缩模型的准确性. 然而,在一般活动识别方面以及在工业组装领域,探索3D CNN的钻探和知识分解的工作很少:大多数现有工作要么针对2D架构,要么孤立地应用压缩技术。

blocks.en:
To close this gap, we introduce a new framework that jointly leverages structured pruning and knowledge distillation on top of a 3D-CNN for fine-grained recognition of industrial assembly activities, enabling model compression while effectively recovering the accuracy typically lost during pruning.
Overall, the key contributions of this work are as follows: • We first establish a strong baseline by benchmarking several compact 3D CNN architectures—including 3D-MobileNet Köpüklü et al. ((2021)) and X3D variants (X3D-M, X3D-L) Feichtenhofer ((2020)) —on the MECCANO dataset for fine-grained industrial assembly recognition.
This analysis compares accuracy, inference time, and model size under realistic deployment constraints and identifies X3D-M as a promising starting point for further optimization. • Introducing Structured Pruning for 3D-CNN Efficiency: To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to explore structured pruning for efficiency optimization of 3D-CNNs in industrial assembly scenarios.
Using L1-norm-based channel pruning at multiple sparsity levels, we significantly reduce computational cost and memory usage while quantifying the corresponding accuracy degradation.
This step reveals both the potential and the limitations of pruning-only compression for fine-grained 3D video understanding. • PDNet: Pruning-Distillation Method for Fine-Grained Industrial HAR: Building on the pruning analysis, we introduce PDNet , a framework that couples L1-norm–based structured pruning of X3D-M with knowledge distillation from a high-capacity SlowFast teacher Feichtenhofer et al. ((2018)) .
Within PDNet, pruning reduces parameters and FLOPs, while distillation is explicitly used to recover the accuracy lost by compression, resulting in a compact 3D-CNN that maintains competitive performance for fine-grained recognition of industrial assembly activities under resource constraints.
blocks.zh:
为了缩小这一差距,我们采用了一个新的框架,在3D-CNN之上联合利用结构化的打磨和知识分馏,对工业组装活动进行精细的识别,使模型压缩成为可能,同时有效恢复了在打磨过程中通常损失的精度。
总体而言,这项工作的主要贡献如下: 我们首先在MECCANO数据集上为若干3D CNN架构——包括3D-MobileNet Köpüklü等(((2021))和X3D变体(X3D-M,X3D-L)Feichtenhofer(((2020)))——设定一个强有力的基线,以进行精细的工业装配识别。
这一分析比较了在现实部署限制下准确性,推断时间,模型大小,并确定了X3D-M作为进一步优化的有希望的起点. • 为3D-CNN效率引入结构化普鲁宁:就我们所知,我们第一个探索在工业组装情景中实现3D-CNN效率优化的结构化普鲁宁。
使用基于 L1- Norm 的通道在多相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
这个步骤揭示了纯pruning压缩对精细的3D视频理解的潜力和局限性. • PDNet:螺旋分裂 精细工业方法 HAR:我们基于推敲分析,引入了PDNet(PDNet),这个框架是情侣L1-Norm-基于X3D-M的有条理的推敲,由高功率的SlowFast教师Feichtenhofer等((2018))进行知识分馏。
在PDNet内部,穿透会减少参数和FLOP,而分馏则被明确用于恢复压缩所损失的精度,从而形成一个紧凑的3D-CNN来保持竞争性能,以便在资源限制下精细地识别工业组装活动.

blocks.en:
We first establish a strong baseline by benchmarking several compact 3D CNN architectures—including 3D-MobileNet Köpüklü et al. ((2021)) and X3D variants (X3D-M, X3D-L) Feichtenhofer ((2020)) —on the MECCANO dataset for fine-grained industrial assembly recognition.
This analysis compares accuracy, inference time, and model size under realistic deployment constraints and identifies X3D-M as a promising starting point for further optimization.

我们首先在MECCANO数据集上为若干3D CNN架构——包括3D-MobileNet Köpüklü等(((2021))和X3D变体(X3D-M,X3D-L)Feichtenhofer(((2020)))——设定一个强有力的基线,以进行精细的工业装配识别。
这一分析比较了在现实部署限制下准确性,推断时间,模型大小,并确定了X3D-M作为进一步优化的有希望的起点.

blocks.en:
Introducing Structured Pruning for 3D-CNN Efficiency: To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to explore structured pruning for efficiency optimization of 3D-CNNs in industrial assembly scenarios.
Using L1-norm-based channel pruning at multiple sparsity levels, we significantly reduce computational cost and memory usage while quantifying the corresponding accuracy degradation.
This step reveals both the potential and the limitations of pruning-only compression for fine-grained 3D video understanding.

PDNet: Pruning-Distillation Method for Fine-Grained Industrial HAR: Building on the pruning analysis, we introduce PDNet , a framework that couples L1-norm–based structured pruning of X3D-M with knowledge distillation from a high-capacity SlowFast teacher Feichtenhofer et al. ((2018)) .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent studies have employed a combination of lightweight model architectures, model compression techniques, and hardware optimization strategies to achieve improved performance. Lightweight 2D CNN-based networks such as MobileNet Prathima et al. ((2025)) and EfficientNet Narayan et al. ((2023)) are frequently adopted for their ability to maintain reasonable accuracy while significantly reducing computational load, making them suitable for deployment on edge devices. Model compression techniques are also widely applied; many existing approaches focus on reducing the memory footprint and latency of deep neural networks while preserving high classification accuracy. One key strategy involves model compression techniques, such as pruning and quantization. Structured pruning methods eliminate entire filters or channels, which align better with hardware execution patterns compared to unstructured sparsity He & Xiao ((2024)) . Techniques like DepGraph Fang et al. ((2023)) further extend structured pruning by incorporating graph representations of neural architectures, enabling fine-grained control over network topology. Quantization reduces model precision (e.g., from 32-bit floating-point to 8-bit integers), and post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) approaches have shown promising results for maintaining accuracy on industrial workloads Novac et al. ((2021)) . Knowledge distillation (KD) compresses large teacher models into lightweight student models without significant loss in accuracy Hinton et al. ((2015)) , with recent work exploring its combination with quantization for additional efficiency gains Tanama et al. ((2023)) .
blocks.zh: 最近的研究采用了轻量级模型架构,模型压缩技术,以及硬件优化策略等组合,以达到更好的性能. 基于有线电视新闻网的轻量级2D网络,如MobileNet Prathima等人((2025))和CeailNet Narayan等人((2023))因其保持合理准确性的能力而经常被采用,同时显著地减少计算负荷,使其适合部署在边缘设备上. 模型压缩技术也得到广泛应用;许多现有方法侧重于减少深神经网络的内存足迹和耐久性,同时保持高分类精度. 一个关键策略涉及模型压缩技术,如打压和量化. 结构化的平流法消除了整个滤波器或通道,与非结构化的Sparsity He & Xiao((2024))相比,这些滤波器或通道更能配合硬件执行模式. DepGraph Fang等人(((2023)))等技术通过纳入神经结构的图示进一步扩展了结构化的穿透,使得能够精细地控制网络地形。 量子化降低了模型精度(例如从32位浮点到8位整数),而训练后量子化(PTQ)和分量化-认知训练(QAT)方法在保持工业工作量精度方面显示出了有希望的结果. Novac等 ((2021). 知识分馏(KD)将大型师范模型压缩为轻量级学生模型而不会在准确度上出现重大损失 Hinton 等 ((2015)) ,近期的工作探索将其与量化相结合,以获得额外的效率收益 Tanama 等 ((2023)).

blocks.en: 3 METHODOLOGY
blocks.zh: 3个方法

blocks.en:
We introduce PDNet , a unified optimization framework designed to obtain resource-efficient 3D-CNNs for fine-grained industrial activity recognition.
PDNet consists of three components that operate sequentially.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了PDNet,这是一个统一的优化框架,旨在获得资源效率高的3D-CNN用于精细的工业活动认证.
PDNet由相继运行的三个组件组成.

blocks.en:
First, we train a compact 3D convolutional neural network (3D-CNN) as our baseline model, described in Section 3.1.1 .
This backbone provides the initial spatiotemporal feature extractor from which all subsequent optimizations are derived.
Second, we apply L1-norm-based structured pruning (Section 3.1.2 ) to reduce the parameter count and computational complexity of the baseline model.
This step produces a compact student network with substantially lower resource demands but also introduces a measurable drop in recognition accuracy.
Finally, we incorporate knowledge distillation (Section 3.1.3 ), using a high-capacity teacher model to guide the training of the pruned student.
This distillation phase recovers much of the performance lost during pruning, resulting in an efficient 3D-CNN that maintains competitive accuracy under strict deployment constraints.
blocks.zh:
第一,我们训练一个紧凑的 三维进化神经网络(3D-CNN)作为我们的基线模型,如第3.1.1节所述。
这个主干提供了初始的spatiotemporal特征提取器,从中可以得出所有后续的优化.
第二,我们采用基于L1-Norm的结构式推算(第3.1.2节)来降低基准模型的参数计算和计算复杂性。
这一步骤产生了一个紧凑的学生网络,资源需求大大降低,但也带来了识别准确度的可衡量下降。
最后,我们纳入了知识分解(第3.1.3节),利用高能力教师模式来指导受压迫学生的培训。
这种蒸馏相恢复了在打磨中损失的大部分性能,导致在严格的部署限制下保持了竞争精度的高效3D-CNN.

blocks.en: 3.1 PDNet: Pruning and Distillation for Recognition of Assembly Activities
blocks.zh: 3.1 PDNet:表彰集会活动的碾磨和蒸馏

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Backbone 3D-CNN
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 后骨3D-CNN

blocks.en:
First, we select an efficient 3D-CNN backbone.
To this end, we benchmark several lightweight 3D architectures on the MECCANO dataset, focusing on the trade-off between accuracy, parameter count, and inference cost.
3D-MobileNet Köpüklü et al. ((2021)) adapts the MobileNetV2 design by utilizing depthwise separable convolutions, which factorize standard 3D kernels to drastically reduce floating-point operations. Alternatively, the X3D family Feichtenhofer ((2020)) optimizes efficiency through a multi-axis expansion strategy, scaling dimensions such as frame rate, duration, and network width independently rather than uniformly. X3D offers a spectrum of variants ranging from the ultra-compact X3D-XS (Extra Small) and X3D-S, designed for edge devices, to larger models like X3D-M, providing a superior trade-off between accuracy and computational complexity compared to traditional heavy models.
Based on this empirical comparison describt in the experiments section, we adopt X3D-M as our baseline 3D-CNN. This model is first optimized in a supervised fashion using the standard cross-entropy loss, and then serves as the starting point for the structured pruning and knowledge distillation stages of PDNet.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们选择一个高效的3D-CNN骨干.
为此,我们在MECCANO数据集上将几个轻量级的三维架构作为基准,侧重于精度,参数计数和推论成本之间的取舍.
3D-MobileNet Köpüklü等 ((2021))通过使用可深度分解的同位素来调整 MobileNetV2 设计,将标准的3D内核作为要素来大幅度地减少浮点操作. 或者,X3D家族的Feichtenhofer((2020))通过多轴扩展策略,独立而非统一地缩放帧率,持续时间和网络宽度等维度来优化效率. X3D提供了从为边缘设备所设计的超共通X3D-XS(Extra Small)和X3D-S到X3D-M等更大型的模型等多种变体的频谱,与传统重型模型相比,提供了精度和计算复杂性的优异取舍.
根据实验部分的这种经验性比较,我们采用X3D-M作为我们的基线3D-CNN. 这个模型首先采用标准跨接力损失的有监督的方式进行优化,再作为PDNet结构化打磨和知识分馏阶段的起点.

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Structured Pruning
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 结构化跑道

blocks.en:
The second stage of PDNet applies structured pruning to reduce model complexity while preserving a hardware-friendly network structure Fang et al. ((2023)) .
Structured pruning accelerates neural networks by removing groups of parameters such as channels or filters, while maintaining structural integrity for efficient inference Fang et al. ((2023)) . Often, the importance of groups is measured by the L1-norm of their weights, which promotes sparsity by encouraging the sum of absolute values of weights to be small. A central concept is the pruning ratio p p , representing the fraction of channels or dimensions removed from each layer. When applied symmetrically to both input and output channels of a convolutional layer, the parameter reduction is approximately Parameter Reduction = 1 − ( 1 − p ) 2 . \text{Parameter Reduction}=1-(1-p)^{2}. For example, a pruning ratio of p = 0.3 p=0.3 (30%) corresponds to around a 51% reduction in parameters.
blocks.zh:
PDNet的第二阶段应用了结构化的穿透来降低模型的复杂性,同时保留了硬件友好的网络结构Fang等 ((2023).
结构分流通过去除通道或滤波器等参数组来加速神经网络,同时为高效推论Fang等((2023).)维护结构完整性. 通常情况下,群体的重要性用其重量的L1-Norm来测量,这通过鼓励绝对值的相和相和的权重而促进痉挛. 一个中心概念是螺旋比p ,代表从每个层去除的通道或维度的分数. 当对等地应用到一个演化层的输入和输出通道时,参数还原大约是参数还原= 1− (1−p) 2.\text{Parameter还原= (1-p)= (1−p)^{2}. 例如,p = 0.3 p = 0.3 (30%)的回推比相当于参数减少51%左右.

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Knowledge Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 知识消沉

blocks.en:
In the third stage of PDNet, we employ knowledge distillation to recover the accuracy lost through structured pruning of the X3D-M backbone.
Knowledge distillation is a model compression technique in deep learning where a large, pre-trained teacher network transfers its knowledge to a smaller student network, enabling the student to achieve competitive accuracy with fewer parameters and lower computational requirements Gou et al. ((2021)) . The teacher generates softened probability outputs through a temperature-controlled softmax function: p i = exp ⁡ ( z i / T ) ∑ j exp ⁡ ( z j / T ) , p_{i}=\frac{\exp(z_{i}/T)}{\sum_{j}\exp(z_{j}/T)}, where z i z_{i} denotes the teacher logits and T > 1 T>1 is the temperature that smooths the distribution to reveal dark knowledge about inter-class relationships Gou et al. ((2021)) . The student is trained to minimize a combination of the standard supervised loss and a distillation loss, which encourages it to mimic the teacher’s softened output distribution. Formally, the loss function is expressed as ℒ = α ⋅ CE ( 𝐲 , 𝐲 ^ s ) + ( 1 − α ) ⋅ T 2 ⋅ KL ( p t ( T ) ∥ p s ( T ) ) , \mathcal{L}=\alpha\cdot\text{CE}(\mathbf{y},\mathbf{\hat{y}}_{s})+(1-\alpha)\cdot T^{2}\cdot\text{KL}(p_{t}(T)\|p_{s}(T)), where α \alpha balances the contribution of the ground-truth labels and teacher outputs, and p t , p s p_{t},p_{s} represents the teacher’s and student’s softened predictions respectively Gou et al. ((2021)) .

blocks.en: 3.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.2 执行细节

blocks.en: The experiments were conducted using the PyTorch framework with the MECCANO dataset Ragusa et al. ((2023)) as the primary benchmark. We trained 3D convolutional models such as 3D-MobileNet and X3D variants using cross-entropy loss and the SGD optimizer, with a base learning rate of 0.1, batch sizes of 12, 32, and 15 respectively, and a cosine annealing schedule over 120 epochs. Based on a trade-off analysis involving recognition accuracy, model size, and inference speed, the X3D-M model was selected as the optimal baseline. Model compression was performed using a structured pruning approach implemented via the Torch-Pruning library Fang et al. ((2023)) , applying an L1-norm channel importance criterion at varying sparsity ratios. Each pruned model was then fine-tuned to recover part of the accuracy loss. To further mitigate the performance degradation introduced by pruning, we applied knowledge distillation using the pre-trained SlowFast model released by the MECCANO dataset authors as the teacher network and the pruned X3D-M model as the student. The student model was trained with a distillation temperature T = 4 T=4 and balancing coefficient α = 0.7 \alpha=0.7 , using a batch size of 16, a base learning rate of 0.1, and the SGD optimizer for 180 epochs. The final optimized model achieved substantial reductions in computational cost while maintaining competitive accuracy suitable for real-time inference.
blocks.zh: 实验采用PyTorch框架,以MECCANO数据集Ragusa等人((2023))作为主要基准。 我们训练了3D-MobileNet和X3D等变体等3D回旋模型,使用跨通损耗和SGD优化器,基础学习率分别为0.1分,分批大小分别为12分,32分和15分等,并采用了超过120个纪元的同位素反射表. 基于对识别精度,模型大小,和推论速度的权衡分析,X3D-M模型被选为最佳基准. 模型压缩采用通过Fang等(((2023))火炬-Pruning库实施的有条理的打压方法进行,采用L1-Norm信道重要性标准,采用不同相撞比例。 每个被磨损的模型随后都进行了微调以弥补部分精度损失. 为了进一步缓解由普鲁斯所引入的性能退化,我们应用了由MECCANO数据集作者作为教师网络发布的预先训练的"慢快"模型和作为学生的被普鲁斯X3D-M模型来进行知识分馏. 该学生模型被训练出蒸馏温度T=4 T=4,平衡系数α=0.7\alpha=0.7,使用批量尺寸为16,基础学习率为0.1,SGD优化器为180个纪元. 最终优化的模型实现了计算成本的大幅降低,同时保持了适合实时推断的竞争性准确性.

blocks.en: 4 EXPERIMENTS
blocks.zh: 4 警告

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark & Metrics Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准和计量细节

blocks.en: The models were benchmarked on the MECCANO Dataset. MECCANO Ragusa et al. ((2023)) is a egocentric dataset designed to model human-object interactions during mechanical assembly. It captures more than 20 hours of video from a first-person perspective, where users manipulate tools and parts to build a small mechanical system. The dataset features fine-grained activity labels and multiple annotators to ensure reliability. This dataset is unique for capturing 61 fine-grained action classes involved in complex assembly procedures and is characterized by a challenging long-tailed class distribution and high intra-class variability. Accuracy relied on standard classification metrics: Top-1 Test Accuracy ( % \% ) and Top-5 Test Accuracy ( % \% ). To accurately assess robustness across all activity types, particularly the rare ones, Mean Per-Class Accuracy was also calculated, addressing the inherent bias posed by the imbalanced class distribution. Computational efficiency was evaluated using three metrics: model size (MB), inference time (ms), and computational cost (GFLOPs). The model size was determined by measuring the disk size of the saved .pth file. The inference time for a single video sample consisting of 16 frames was measured using the PyTorch profiler by averaging the forward-pass latency over 1000 iterations. The theoretical computational complexity, expressed in GFLOPs (billions of floating-point operations), represents the total number of operations required for a single forward pass of the model. All measurements were conducted on an AMD EPYC 7502P 32-core CPU.
blocks.zh: 这些模型以MECCANO数据集为基准。 MECCANO Ragusa等 ((2023))是一个以自我为中心的数据集,旨在为机械组装过程中的人类-物体相互作用建模. 它从第一人称视角捕捉了超过20小时的视频,用户操纵工具和部件来构建一个小型机械系统. 该数据集具有精细的活性标签和多条注释器,以确保可靠性. 这个数据集对于捕获参与复杂组装程序的61个精细的动作类是独一无二的,其特点是具有挑战性的长尾类分布和高级内部可变性. 准确性依赖于标准分类衡量标准:Top-1测试准确性(%\%)和Top-5测试准确性(%\%). 为了准确评估所有活动类型的稳健性,特别是稀有活动类型的稳健性,还计算出每类平均准确性,解决了阶级分布不平衡造成的固有偏差。 计算效率采用三个衡量标准:模型大小(MB)、推断时间(ms)和计算成本(GFLOPs)。 模型大小是通过测量所保存的.pth文件的磁盘大小来确定的. 由16个帧组成的单一视频样本的推断时间是使用PyTorch剖面仪通过将前传间隔平均于1000个迭代来测量的. 以GFLOPs(十亿个浮点操作)表示的理论计算复杂度,代表了该模型单向前传所需的操作总数. 所有测量都用AMD EMYC 7502P 32核心CPU进行.

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: Several compact 3D convolutional architectures, including 3D-MobileNet, X3D-L, and X3D-M, were evaluated using the PySlowFast framework against the high-capacity reference model SlowFast Ragusa et al. ((2023)) , which achieved the highest accuracy (45.16% Top-1). Among the lightweight candidates, 3D-MobileNet achieved 27.31% Top-1 and X3D-L achieved 34.50% Top-1. Consequently, the X3D-M model was selected as the optimal baseline for subsequent optimization because it achieved the highest Top-1 accuracy (36.49%) among compact models.
blocks.zh: 利用PySlowFast框架与高能参考模型SlowFast Ragusa等(((2023)))进行了包括3D-MobileNet,X3D-L,和X3D-M在内的多款紧凑的3D回旋架构评价,取得了最高精度(45.16% Top-1). 在轻量级候选人中,3D-MobileNet实现了27.31%的Top-1,X3D-L达到了34.50%的Top-1. 因此,X3D-M模型被选为随后优化的最佳基准,因为它在紧凑模型中达到了最高的Top-1精度(36.49%).

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of baseline models on the Meccano dataset against SlowFast Model
blocks.zh: 表1:麦加诺数据集基准模型与慢速模型的比较

blocks.en: To evaluate the effect of structured pruning on the baseline X3D-M model, we gradually increased the pruning ratio from no pruning up to 25%. At each pruning ratio, the least important filters were removed to reduce model complexity while retaining as much representational capacity as possible. The resulting models were analyzed in terms of model size, latency, and computational cost (GFLOPs). The experiments showed that as the pruning ratio increased, model size and computational cost decreased, but this was accompanied by some degradation in accuracy. For example, pruning up to 25% reduced the model size by approximately 41% while maintaining a reasonable level of performance, highlighting the trade-off between efficiency and predictive capability.
blocks.zh: 为了评价结构化的打压对基线X3D-M模型的影响,我们逐渐将打压比从无打压提高到25%. 在每个推算比上,都去掉了最不重要的滤波器来降低模型复杂度,同时尽可能地保留了代表能力. 从模型大小、耐久性和计算成本等角度对模型进行了分析。 实验显示,随着穿透率的提高,模型尺寸和计算成本都有所下降,但伴随着精度的下降. 例如,在保持合理性能水平的同时,高达25%的钻探将模型大小减少了约41%,突出了效率和预测能力之间的取舍。

blocks.zh: 表2:结果总结

blocks.en: Table 3: Comparison of the different variants of the X3D-M model. The pruning and fine-tuning approach achieves large efficiency gains while maintaining competitive accuracy.
blocks.zh: 表3:X3D-M型不同变体的比较. 推敲和微调方法在保持竞争准确性的同时,实现了高效益.

blocks.en: The subsequent phase, focused on accuracy recovery, utilized Knowledge Distillation (KD) to fine-tune the highly compressed X3D-M student model using the high-capacity SlowFast teacher model. This combined Pruned + KD strategy was remarkably successful, yielding a final model that achieved a Top-1 accuracy of 39.46% and a Top-5 accuracy of 68.72%. Crucially, this optimization not only recovered the significant performance drop caused by pruning (which reduced Top-1 accuracy from 35.40% to 25.54%) but also enabled the student model to surpass the performance of the original uncompressed X3D-M baseline model by 4.06 percentage points (39.46% vs. 35.40%). However, the class-based accuracy analysis presented a more nuanced view: the overall mean class accuracy slightly declined from 12.01% (original X3D-M) to 10.95% (Pruned + KD model), a decrease of 1.06%. This divergence between high Top-1 accuracy and low mean per-class accuracy is largely due to the highly imbalanced, long-tailed class distribution of the 61 fine-grained action classes present in the MECCANO dataset, where many rare actions are difficult to classify. Despite the slight drop in mean performance, KD significantly boosted accuracy for several key frequent classes, such as check_booklet (improving by + 11.68 % +11.68\% ) and tighten_bolt_with_hands ( + 4.54 % +4.54\% ). Conversely, some visually or temporally complex fine-grained actions, such as fit_rim_tire ( − 17.65 % -17.65\% ) and put_red_4_perforated_junction_bar ( − 20.00 % -20.00\% ), saw decreases, highlighting the limitations of the reduced model capacity for certain tail classes. Overall, the resulting Pruned + KD model maintained the efficiency of the pruned version (6.90 MB, 3.78 GFLOPs) while providing a substantial performance recovery, confirming the efficacy of this joint optimization approach for practical, real-time HAR deployment as shown in figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 随后的阶段侧重于精度回收,利用"知识分解"(KD)来微调高压缩的X3D-M学生模型,并使用高容量的"慢快"教师模型. 这项合并的Pruned + KD策略取得了显著的成功,最终的模型达到了Top-1的精度39.46%和Top-5的精度68.72%. 关键是,这一优化不仅恢复了由普跑导致的显著性能下降(将Top-1精度从35.40%降低到25.54%),还使学生模式超越了原先未压缩的X3D-M基准模型的性能4.06个百分点(39.46%对35.40%). 然而,基于类的准确性分析呈现出更细微的视角:总体平均类精度从12.01%(原X3D-M)略为下降至10.95%(Pruned + KD模型),下降1.06%. 高Top-1精度与低平均每等精度之间的这种差异,主要是由于MECCANO数据集中存在的61个精度动作类的高度不平衡而长尾的类分布,其中许多罕见动作难以分类. 尽管平均性能略有下降,但KD大大提高了几个关键常见类的精度,例如:check_booklet(改进了+11.68 % +11.68 + ) 和收紧了-bolt_ with-hands(+4.54% +4.54 + 4.54 + + 4⁄4) 反之,一些视觉或时间上复杂的精细行为,如fit_rim_tire(-17.65% - 17.65 + ) 和 put_red_4_perforated_junction_bar(-20.00 % - 20.00 + ) , 出现了减少,突出了某些尾等类模型容量下降的局限性。 总的来说,由此产生的Pruned + KD模型保持了被pred版本(6.90 MB,3.78 GFLOPs)的效率,同时提供了实质性的性能恢复,证实了图1所示的这种联合优化方法对于实际的实时HAR部署的功效.

blocks.en: 5 CONCLUSIONS
blocks.zh: 5个结论

blocks.en: In this work, we proposed a resource-efficient optimization pipeline for 3D-CNNs tailored to real-time human activity recognition in industrial assembly settings. By selecting X3D-M as a compact baseline and applying structured pruning followed by knowledge distillation from a SlowFast teacher model, we achieved substantial reductions in model size and computational cost while improving Top-1 accuracy beyond the original model. The final compressed model maintains strong performance at only 3.78 GFLOPs and 6.90 MB, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining pruning and distillation for deployment in resource-constrained Industry 4.0 environments. While the current results are promising, further experiments are needed to fully explore the potential of this optimization pipeline. Future work could investigate alternative student-teacher combinations to identify more effective distillation pairings, evaluate different pruning strategies or sparsity levels, and assess the generalizability of the approach across other datasets or activity domains. Additionally, benchmarking the compressed models on a wider range of hardware platforms, including edge devices and industrial-grade embedded systems, will provide deeper insights into real-world performance and latency characteristics. These investigations will help refine the pipeline and ensure robust, efficient deployment in diverse industrial scenarios.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了3D-CNN的资源效率优化管道,以适应工业装配环境下的实时人类活动认可. 通过选择X3D-M作为紧凑的基线,并采用结构化的穿透,然后从慢速师范模型中进行知识分馏,我们实现了模型大小和计算成本的大幅削减,同时在原模型之外提高了Top-1的精度. 最终的压缩模型仅维持了3.78 GFLOP和6.90 MB的强效性能,证明了在资源受限的工业 4.0 环境中结合出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 虽然目前的结果很有希望,但还需要进行进一步试验来充分探索这一优化管道的潜力。 今后的工作可以调查其他学生-教师组合,以确定更有效的蒸馏配对方法,评价不同的挤压策略或抽筋水平,并评估该方法在其他数据集或活动领域的通用性。 此外,在包括边缘装置和工业级嵌入系统在内的更广泛的硬件平台上制定压缩模型的基准,将更深入地了解现实世界的性能和耐用性。 这些调查将有助于改进管道,并确保在各种工业情况下进行有力而有效的部署。
